# Quantum Local Correlation Energy

> An explicit quantum compiler for a nonuniform discrete-Poisson LCCSD energy density, with full preparation/execution/output accounting and a matched classical variational countercheck.

## Canonical reading order

- [Overview](science/overview.md): supported proposition and scientific scope.
- [Model and task](science/model-and-task.md): finite input, stationary reference, SD Hermiticity and error contract.
- [Coulomb access](science/coulomb-access.md): neutral projector and controlled Green-column overlaps.
- [SD compiler](science/singles-doubles-compiler.md): direct/exchange decomposition and rank-changing incidence.
- [Gap and signal](science/gap-and-signal.md): actual inverse gap and nonzero requested output.
- [Scalar estimation](science/scalar-estimation.md): source, selected products, QSVT and finite Neumann route.
- [Resources](science/resources-and-regimes.md): arithmetic, precision, confidence and logical budgets.
- [Classical comparison](science/classical-comparison.md): exact FFT MP2, full-residual variational method and observed numerical results.
- [Related work](references/related-work.md): inherited methods, closest work and comparison limits.
- [Verification](verification/README.md): scripts, dependencies, outputs and validation scope.

## Interpretation boundaries

- No practical quantum advantage is demonstrated for the worked parameter family.
- Constant normalization depends on the stated finite model and charged procedural input access.
- The full Coulomb convolution is not encoded at constant normalization; the charged operator is diagonal on retained position labels.
- Intermediate success projectors are essential; multiplying complete preparation unitaries can encode the wrong operator.
- Physical contraction q and circuit normalization beta have different roles.
- Numerical residual bounds use double precision, not interval-certified arithmetic.
- Analytical gate budgets are not compiled hardware counts or physical runtime predictions.
- LCCSD accuracy within this effective model is separate from exact material accuracy.
- The SD identity does not automatically extend to LCCSDT.
- The repository makes no absolute priority claim.
